summary: Completed testing of redesigned checkout page (/checkout/:planoId). All features working correctly: public checkout shows registration form with all required fields, upgrade checkout shows logged-in user card with Verificado badge, form submission creates PIX charge via SyncPay and redirects to payment page, coupon validation works (shows error for invalid coupons), order summary displays plan info correctly.
passed_tests: Frontend /checkout/basico - Shows registration form with Nome, Email, Senha, Confirmar Senha, CPF, Telefone fields
Frontend /checkout/basico - PIX payment method selected by default for SyncPay gateway
Frontend /checkout/basico - Submit button shows 'Confirmar Pagamento R$ 97,00'
Frontend /checkout/profissional?upgrade=true - Shows logged-in user card (Diego Haidmann, diego.haidmann@gmail.com)
Frontend /checkout/profissional?upgrade=true - Shows Verificado badge on user card
Frontend /checkout/profissional?upgrade=true - Does NOT show registration fields (correct behavior)
Frontend Order Summary - Shows plan name (Plano Básico/Profissional)
Frontend Order Summary - Shows price (R$ 97,00 / R$ 197,00)
Frontend Order Summary - Shows features (Relatórios PDF, Suporte por email, etc.)
Frontend Order Summary - Shows limits (Até 50 clientes, Até 100 empréstimos)
Frontend Coupon - Input field and Apply button present
Frontend Coupon - Invalid coupon shows error 'Cupom não encontrado'
Frontend Trust Signals - Shows 'Criptografia de ponta a ponta' and 'Pagamento 100% seguro via SyncPay'
Frontend Form Submission - Creates PIX charge and redirects to /checkout-syncpay-pagamento
Frontend Payment Page - Shows PIX code 'copia e cola' with copy button
Frontend Payment Page - Shows status 'Aguardando confirmação do pagamento...'
Backend POST /api/assinaturas/checkout-syncpay - Creates PIX charge, returns pix_code and transaction_id
Backend GET /api/assinaturas/gateway/disponiveis - Returns syncpay gateway with metodos=['pix']
Backend pytest - All 8 SyncPay integration tests passed (100%)
